title: Frequently Asked Questions.
subtitle: Understand how AlGhaf Collective structures approvals, delivery, and installation.
content: Understand how AlGhaf Collective structures approvals, delivery, and installation.

items.title: Do AlGhaf modular homes comply with UAE municipal building regulations?
items.question: Do AlGhaf modular homes comply with UAE municipal building regulations?
items.answer: Yes. All AlGhaf structural frames and building envelopes are engineered in full alignment with UAE building codes, Dubai Municipality regulations, and GCC civil defense fire safety standards.

items.title: How long does the entire process take from agreement to handover?
items.question: How long does the entire process take from agreement to handover?
items.answer: Standard modular delivery ranges from 6 to 14 weeks depending on the selected collection (MOVA: 6–10 weeks, PENTA: 8–14 weeks, ENTRA: 6–8 weeks). Because ground preparation and factory prefabrication run in parallel, on-site installation takes only 1 to 3 days.

items.title: Can the interior layouts and finishes be customized?
items.question: Can the interior layouts and finishes be customized?
items.answer: Yes. While structural chassis dimensions are standardized for optimal factory engineering and transport, all interior millwork, kitchen joinery, flooring materials, sanitary ware, and smart home controls can be personalized.

items.title: What site foundations are required for installation?
items.question: What site foundations are required for installation?
items.answer: Our modular units can be installed on reinforced concrete strip footings, low-impact steel helical screw piles, or grade beams. Our engineering team conducts a thorough site evaluation before foundation works commence.
